name: Julian R. Moreau, M.T.S.
title: Catholic Speaker, Retreat Leader & Pastoral Facilitator
tagline: Rekindling Sacramental Wonder, Eucharistic Faith & Apostolic Courage
bioSummary: Rooted in the contemplative depth and joyful evangelistic spirit of New Orleans, Julian Moreau is a sought-after Catholic speaker, retreat master, and pastoral strategist. For over sixteen years, he has guided parishes, dioceses, and Catholic educators toward renewing their encounter with Jesus Christ in the Eucharist and reclaiming their apostolic missionary identity.
fullNarrative: Julian was formed in the rich spiritual tradition of the Catholic South, graduating with honors from Notre Dame Seminary in New Orleans with a Master of Theological Studies (M.T.S.) concentrating on Systematic Theology and the Sacraments.

Having served as a parish director of evangelization, high school campus minister, and diocesan consultant, Julian brings grounded pastoral realism paired with theological gravitas. He bridges intellectual orthodoxy with warm, humor-laced Southern storytelling.

Julian resides in New Orleans with his wife, Claire, and their four children. When not traveling for parish missions and diocesan convocations, he can often be found prayerfully walking the historic river levee, playing Delta blues slide guitar, or hosting hospitality dinners for local young adult ministers.
